_comment: Named address ranges of the Test Drive Unlimited (Europe, title 494707D4, default.xex) image for the inventory. kind: library = statically linked SDK code, replaced as a unit by Any360 (not decompiled); middleware = third-party engine code the title links (physics, video): neither the title's own code nor something Any360 provides, so it stays recompiled or is replaced by the vendor's library for the target, never decompiled function by function; game = the title's own code (here Eden's ed* libraries too: edMath, edFlash, edFile, edNet, edAudio). Evidence, three kinds, read together: (1) functions with the same sequence of instruction mnemonics (14 instructions or more) as a function of Crackdown or The Simpsons Game, clustered: the three titles link the same XDK libraries, and Havok; (2) the strings each range refers to (lis/addi pairs into the image): Havok's source paths and messages ('.\collide\mopp\machine\hkMoppLongRayVirtualMachine.cpp', '** Havok libs built with version [', '.\serialize\xml\hkXmlObjectWriter.cpp'), D3D's ('ERR[D3D]: Unanticipated CPU_INTERRUPT', 'The GPU is hung!  D3D version is %i.%i'), XAPI's ('[XAPI RETURN VALUE] %d'), Bink's ('Not a Bink file.', 'Error reading Bink header.'); (3) the system calls each range makes: Vd* from the D3D runtime, XAudio* and XMA* from the audio range, XMsg* / XamSession* / XNetLogon* / XamVoice* from the Live ranges, KeTls* / KeBugCheck / RtlUnwind from the CRT, Nt*File / XamContent* / XamShow* from XAPI. The D3D range matches Crackdown's D3D runtime (0x826A0000) and The Simpsons Game's command writers (0x82461500); the CRT range holds the register save / restore helpers (Crackdown's bytes at 0x82ABD000 are at 0x82644200) and matches The Simpsons Game's CRT (0x82A3C000); the import thunks (0x82B7E734-0x82B7FBA4, the addresses generated tdu_init.cpp binds) hold no function of their own and sit right before Bink. Boundaries are the first and last function with such evidence, so a range may be a little short, not long. Not named for want of evidence: 0x8269DE20-0x826A7AF8 (code the three titles share, purpose unknown), 0x82784000-0x82790000 (an XML parser, D3D error names), 0x82608000-0x82610000 (zlib's inflate messages next to edCinematic), 0x826DD328-0x826FFE98 (a JPEG path), 0x82B74000-0x82B7E734 (static initializers of the whole program). Ranges outside the list are reported by 1 MB area until symbol recovery names them.
